user.title: Peplink Router
user.description: Enter the router's address and choose an authentication method.

data_description.instance_name: Display name for this router (e.g. Rockwood Peplink)
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable if your router uses a self-signed certificate

data.username: Admin username (optional — for SpeedFusion Connect & diagnostics)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure router connection
reconfigure.description:
Change the router URL or SSL verification, for example after switching the router's web admin to HTTPS (use https://...). The new settings are checked with the stored credentials before saving.

The local admin username/password are optional with token auth: they enable SpeedFusion Connect data and thermal/fan diagnostics, which use the web-admin session that token auth alone can't reach. Leave the password blank to keep the stored one; clear both to remove them.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the router. Check the URL and network.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.
error.invalid_admin_auth: Admin login failed — check the username/password.

abort.already_configured: This router instance is already configured.

get_cellular_bands.name: Get cellular bands
get_cellular_bands.description: Reads each SIM's band selection on one cellular modem, the bands the modem supports and the live carrier data. Returns the result as a response.

set_cellular_bands.name: Set cellular bands
set_cellular_bands.description: Sets which bands one SIM of a cellular modem may use, or returns it to Auto, then reads the setting back to verify it. Applying restarts that modem about 25-30 seconds later, so its link drops briefly. A request matching the current setting changes nothing.

sim.name: SIM
sim.description: SIM slot to change. Defaults to the active SIM.

bands.name: Bands
bands.description: Band names such as LTE_B2, LTE_B66, 5G_NSA_B66 or WCDMA_850 (LTE shorthand like B12 or 12 also works). Use 'auto' or an empty list for Auto. The Band Selection sensor lists the supported bands.

wait_for_connection.name: Wait for connection
wait_for_connection.description: Seconds to wait for the modem to restart and reconnect before returning (0 = don't wait; use 90 or more). The response reports whether it reconnected.
